name: Your Girlfriend Wants To Try Diapers, But YOU Have To Buy Them
source:
It's too embarrassing!

Part of you really wants to wear cute adult diapers and act out your closely-held fantasies, but the mere thought of having to buy them at the store terrifies you.

But now your girlfriend wants to try them too. Will this finally give you the motivation you need to push through your fears?

太让人难为情了！

你心里很想穿上可爱的成人纸尿裤，体验一直藏在心底的幻想，可光是想到要去店里买，就吓得不行。

如今，女友也想试试纸尿裤。这能不能终于给你鼓起勇气、克服恐惧的动力？
